```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(writexl)

folder <- "C:/Users/ranve/Documents/Bioinformatics/Individual project"


#Births
births <- read_excel(file.path(folder, "only_birth.xlsx"))
names(births) <- trimws(names(births))

births <- births %>%
  rename(area_code = 1) %>%
  mutate(area_code = as.character(area_code),
         births = as.numeric(gsub(",", "", `Number of live births`)),
         stillbirths = as.numeric(gsub(",", "", `Number of stillbirths`))) %>%
  filter(str_detect(area_code, "^E")) %>%
  group_by(area_code) %>%
  summarise(
    births = sum(births, na.rm = TRUE),
    stillbirths = sum(stillbirths, na.rm = TRUE),
    stillbirth_rate_per_1000 = ifelse(births > 0, (stillbirths / births) * 1000, NA_real_),
    .groups = "drop")


#IMD
imd <- imd_raw %>%
  mutate(area_code = as.character(Local.Authority.District.code..2024.),
         IMD_rank = as.numeric(Index.of.Multiple.Deprivation..IMD..Rank..where.1.is.most.deprived.)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(area_code), area_code != "") %>%
  group_by(area_code) %>%
  summarise(IMD_rank = median(IMD_rank, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")


#Ethnicity
eth_summary <- read_excel(file.path(folder, "ethnicities.xlsx")) %>%
  setNames(make.names(trimws(names(.)))) %>%
  mutate(area_code = as.character(Lower.Tier.Local.Authorities.Code),
         ethnic_group = as.character(Ethnic.Group..detailed...288.categories.),
         value = as.numeric(Observation),
         is_white = str_detect(ethnic_group, regex("^White", ignore_case = TRUE))) %>%
  filter(!is.na(area_code), area_code != "") %>%
  group_by(area_code) %>%
  summarise(
    total_pop = sum(value, na.rm = TRUE),
    white_pop = sum(value[is_white], na.rm = TRUE),
    ethnic_minority_pop = sum(value[!is_white], na.rm = TRUE),
    ethnic_minority_pct = ifelse(total_pop > 0,
                                 round(100 * ethnic_minority_pop / total_pop, 2),
                                 NA_real_),
    .groups = "drop")


#Merging IMD and ethnicity
final <- births %>%
  left_join(imd, by = "area_code") %>%
  left_join(eth_summary, by = "area_code")

#Remove rows with missing deprivation or ethnicity data
final <- final %>%
  filter(!is.na(IMD_rank),
         !is.na(ethnic_minority_pct))

#Export output
write_xlsx(final, file.path(folder, "final_stillbirth_dataset_2025.xlsx"))
```


```{r}
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

#Download LAD shapefile
url <- paste0(
  "https://services1.arcgis.com/ESMARspQHYMw9BZ9/arcgis/rest/services/",
  "Local_Authority_Districts_May_2024_Boundaries_UK_BGC/FeatureServer/0/query",
  "?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&f=geojson")

lad <- st_read(url, quiet = TRUE)

st_write(lad, file.path(folder, "LAD_2024_UK_BGC.gpkg"), delete_dsn = TRUE)

#Keep only LADs in the dataset
final_lad <- final %>%
  filter(str_detect(area_code, "^E"))

#Join spatial data
lad_data <- lad %>% left_join(final_lad, by = c("LAD24CD" = "area_code"))

#Stillbirth plot
stillbirth_plot <- ggplot(lad_data) +
  geom_sf(
    aes(fill = stillbirth_rate_per_1000),
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.1
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "plasma",
    na.value = "grey95",
    name = "Stillbirths\nper 1000"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(title = "Stillbirth rate by Local Authority District")

ggsave(file.path(folder, "stillbirth_rate_map.png"),
       stillbirth_plot, width = 8, height = 10, dpi = 300)

#IMD plot
imd_plot <- ggplot(lad_data) +
  geom_sf(
    aes(fill = IMD_rank),
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.1
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "magma",
    direction = -1,
    na.value = "grey95",
    name = "Median\nIMD Rank"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(title = "Index of Multiple Deprivation by Local Authority District")

ggsave(file.path(folder, "imd_map.png"),
       imd_plot, width = 8, height = 10, dpi = 300)

#Ethnic minority plot
ethnicity_plot <- ggplot(lad_data) +
  geom_sf(
    aes(fill = ethnic_minority_pct),
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.1
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "cividis",
    na.value = "grey95",
    name = "Ethnic\nMinority %"
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  labs(title = "Ethnic minority population (%) by Local Authority District")

ggsave(file.path(folder, "ethnic_minority_map.png"),
       ethnicity_plot, width = 8, height = 10, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(scales)

scatter_folder <- file.path(folder, "scatter plots")
dir.create(scatter_folder, showWarnings = FALSE)

final <- final %>%
  mutate(log_stillbirth_rate = log1p(stillbirth_rate_per_1000))

#Stillbirth rate vs IMD
imd_scatter <- ggplot(filter(final, !is.na(IMD_rank)),
                      aes(x = IMD_rank, y = log_stillbirth_rate)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, colour = "steelblue") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, colour = "red") +
  labs(
    title = "Stillbirth rate vs IMD rank",
    x = "Median IMD rank (lower = more deprived)",
    y = "Log(1 + stillbirth rate per 1,000 births)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave(file.path(scatter_folder, "scatter_imd.png"),
       imd_scatter, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)

#Stillbirth rate vs ethnic minority percentage
ethnicity_scatter <- ggplot(filter(final, !is.na(ethnic_minority_pct)),
                            aes(x = ethnic_minority_pct, y = log_stillbirth_rate)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, colour = "purple") +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, colour = "red") +
  labs(
    title = "Stillbirth rate vs ethnic minority population",
    x = "Ethnic minority population (%)",
    y = "Log(1 + stillbirth rate per 1,000 births)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

ggsave(file.path(scatter_folder, "scatter_ethnicity.png"),
       ethnicity_scatter, width = 7, height = 5, dpi = 300)
```

```{r}
library(CARBayes)
library(sf)
library(spdep)
library(dplyr)
library(writexl)
library(stringr)

lad_model <- lad_data %>%
  left_join(final, by = c("LAD24CD" = "area_code"))

lad_model <- lad_model %>%
  rename(
    stillbirths = stillbirths.x,
    births = births.x,
    IMD_rank = IMD_rank.x,
    ethnic_minority_pct = ethnic_minority_pct.x
  )


#Scale predictors
lad_model <- lad_model %>%
  mutate(
    IMD_rank_scaled = as.numeric(scale(IMD_rank)),
    ethnic_minority_pct_scaled = as.numeric(scale(ethnic_minority_pct))
  )


#England model data
england_sf <- lad_model %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(IMD_rank_scaled),
    !is.na(ethnic_minority_pct_scaled),
    !is.na(stillbirths),
    !is.na(births),
    births > 0,
    str_detect(LAD24CD, "^E")
  )

england_sf <- england_sf[card(poly2nb(england_sf, queen = TRUE)) > 0, ]

england_data <- england_sf %>%
  st_drop_geometry()

england_nb <- poly2nb(england_sf, queen = TRUE)

england_W <- listw2mat(nb2listw(england_nb, style = "B"))
england_W <- (england_W + t(england_W)) / 2
england_W <- ifelse(england_W > 0, 1, 0)


england_model <- S.CARleroux(
  formula = stillbirths ~ IMD_rank_scaled +
    ethnic_minority_pct_scaled +
    offset(log(births)),
  family = "poisson",
  data = england_data,
  W = england_W,
  burnin = 10000,
  n.sample = 50000
)


#Regression coefficients and confidence intervals
england_results <- england_model$summary.results %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  mutate(
    parameter = rownames(.),
    model = "England"
  )


beta_results <- england_results


#Spatial correlation parameter
spatial_results <- data.frame(
  model = "England",
  spatial_correlation = england_model$summary.results["rho", "Mean"]
)


#Unexplained spatial variance
england_variance <- data.frame(
  model = "England",
  unexplained_variance = var(as.vector(england_model$samples$phi))
)

variance_results <- england_variance


#Combine results
CARBayes_results <- list(
  regression_coefficients = beta_results,
  spatial_correlation = spatial_results,
  unexplained_variance = variance_results
)


write_xlsx(
  CARBayes_results,
  file.path(folder, "CARBayes_model_results.xlsx")
)
```

```{r}
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(viridis)

#Define hotspot threshold (example: national average)
threshold <- 3.9

#Posterior fitted means for each LAD
posterior_lambda <- england_model$samples$fitted

#Convert to posterior stillbirth rate per 1,000 live births
posterior_rate <- sweep(
  posterior_lambda,
  2,
  england_data$births,
  "/"
) * 1000

#Posterior probability each LAD exceeds the threshold
hotspot_probability <- colMeans(posterior_rate > threshold)

#Add probabilities to England sf object
england_sf$hotspot_probability <- hotspot_probability

#Read UK LAD map
uk_lad <- st_read(
  file.path(folder, "LAD_2024_UK_BGC.gpkg"),
  quiet = TRUE
)

#Join hotspot probabilities to the UK map
uk_map <- uk_lad %>%
  left_join(
    england_sf %>%
      st_drop_geometry() %>%
      select(LAD24CD, hotspot_probability),
    by = "LAD24CD"
  )

#Plot
hotspot_map <- ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = uk_map,
    fill = "grey90",
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.15
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = filter(uk_map, !is.na(hotspot_probability)),
    aes(fill = hotspot_probability),
    colour = "white",
    linewidth = 0.15
  ) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(
    option = "plasma",
    limits = c(0, 1),
    na.value = "grey90",
    name = "Posterior\nprobability"
  ) +
  labs(
    title = paste(
      "Posterior probability of exceeding",
      threshold,
      "stillbirths per 1,000 live births"
    )
  ) +
  theme_void()

ggsave(
  file.path(folder, "posterior_hotspot_probability_map.png"),
  hotspot_map,
  width = 8,
  height = 10,
  dpi = 300
)

hotspot_map
```

```{r}
#MAE and RMSE

library(readxl)
library(dplyr)

#LOOCV files

ethnicity_LOOCV <- read_excel("LOOCV_ethnicity_model.xlsx")

full_LOOCV <- read_excel("LOOCV_full_model.xlsx")

IMD_LOOCV <- read_excel("LOOCV_IMD_model.xlsx")

null_LOOCV <- read_excel("LOOCV_null_model.xlsx")


#Calculate MAE and RMSE for each model

#Ethnicity model
MAE_ethnicity <- mean(
  abs(ethnicity_LOOCV$observed - ethnicity_LOOCV$predicted),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

RMSE_ethnicity <- sqrt(
  mean(
    (ethnicity_LOOCV$observed - ethnicity_LOOCV$predicted)^2,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
)


#Full model
MAE_full <- mean(
  abs(full_LOOCV$observed - full_LOOCV$predicted),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

RMSE_full <- sqrt(
  mean(
    (full_LOOCV$observed - full_LOOCV$predicted)^2,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
)


#IMD model
MAE_IMD <- mean(
  abs(IMD_LOOCV$observed - IMD_LOOCV$predicted),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

RMSE_IMD <- sqrt(
  mean(
    (IMD_LOOCV$observed - IMD_LOOCV$predicted)^2,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
)


#Null model
MAE_null <- mean(
  abs(null_LOOCV$observed - null_LOOCV$predicted),
  na.rm = TRUE
)

RMSE_null <- sqrt(
  mean(
    (null_LOOCV$observed - null_LOOCV$predicted)^2,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
)


#Summary table

LOOCV_results <- data.frame(
  Model = c(
    "Null model",
    "IMD model",
    "Ethnicity model",
    "Full model"
  ),
  
  MAE = c(
    MAE_null,
    MAE_IMD,
    MAE_ethnicity,
    MAE_full
  ),
  
  RMSE = c(
    RMSE_null,
    RMSE_IMD,
    RMSE_ethnicity,
    RMSE_full
  )
)

LOOCV_results <- LOOCV_results %>%
  mutate(
    MAE = round(MAE, 3),
    RMSE = round(RMSE, 3)
  )

LOOCV_results

#Calculate percentage improvement compared to null model


LOOCV_results <- LOOCV_results %>%
  mutate(
    MAE_improvement_percent =
      ((MAE_null - MAE) / MAE_null) * 100,
    
    RMSE_improvement_percent =
      ((RMSE_null - RMSE) / RMSE_null) * 100
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    MAE_improvement_percent =
      round(MAE_improvement_percent, 2),
    
    RMSE_improvement_percent =
      round(RMSE_improvement_percent, 2)
  )

LOOCV_results
```
